title: 2019 Panini Prestige - Rookie #232 Rashan Gary (RC) Packers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: It is a 2019 Panini Prestige sports trading card featuring rookie player Rashan Gary from the Green Bay Packers in the National Football League (NFL). The card is part of the base set and is numbered 232. It is not autographed and is manufactured by Panini.
